62: internal enum class LabPlacementMotion { CIRCULAR, RELEASE, CUSTOM }
63: internal enum class LabPlacementDirection { PROGRADE, RETROGRADE }
64: 
65: internal data class LabPlacementHost(val id: String, val name: String)
66: 
67: /** All values and preview messages come from the live placement model. */
68: internal data class LabPlacementUiState(
69:     val hostBodyId: String,
70:     val hosts: List<LabPlacementHost>,
71:     val planeLabel: String,
72:     val altitudeKmText: String,
73:     val altitudeRangeKm: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>,
74:     val motion: LabPlacementMotion,
75:     val speedKmPerSecondText: String,
76:     val direction: LabPlacementDirection,
77:     val previewStatus: String,
78:     val previewHorizonText: String? = null,
79:     val error: String? = null,
80:     val canCreate: Boolean = true,
81:     val committing: Boolean = false,
82:     val altitudeLocked: Boolean = false,
83:     val headingDegreesText: String = "90",
84: )
85: 
86: internal data class LabPlacementActions(
87:     val onHostChange: (String) -> Unit,
88:     val onAltitudeChange: (String) -> Unit,
89:     val onMotionChange: (LabPlacementMotion) -> Unit,
90:     val onSpeedChange: (String) -> Unit,
91:     val onDirectionChange: (LabPlacementDirection) -> Unit,
92:     val onCreate: () -> Unit,
93:     val onCancel: () -> Unit,
94:     val onAltitudeLockChange: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
95:     val onHeadingChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
96: )
97: 
98: internal object LabPlacementTags {
99:     const val ROOT = "lab.placement"
100:     const val CONTENT = "lab.placement.content"
101:     const val ALTITUDE = "lab.placement.altitude"
102:     const val ALTITUDE_SLIDER = "lab.placement.altitude.slider"
103:     const val ALTITUDE_LOCK = "lab.placement.altitude.lock"
104:     const val SPEED = "lab.placement.speed"
105:     const val HEADING = "lab.placement.heading"
106:     const val PREVIEW = "lab.placement.preview"
107:     const val CREATE = LabTags.PROBE_COMMIT
108:     const val CANCEL = "lab.placement.cancel"
109:     const val SECTION_POSITION = "lab.placement.section.position"
110:     const val SECTION_MOTION = "lab.placement.section.motion"
111:     fun host(id: String) = "lab.placement.host.$id"
112:     fun motion(value: LabPlacementMotion) = "lab.placement.motion.${value.name.lowercase(Locale.US)}"
113:     fun direction(value: LabPlacementDirection) = "lab.placement.direction.${value.name.lowercase(Locale.US)}"
114: }

116: internal object LabPlacementMetrics {
117:     val SceneHeaderHeight = 56.dp
118:     val PortraitHeight = 312.dp
119:     val LandscapeWidth = 344.dp
120: }
121: 
122: private enum class PlacementSection { POSITION, MOTION }
123: 
124: /** The scene has one title; the panel below it describes position and motion. */
125: @Composable
126: internal fun LabPlacementSceneBar(
127:     planeLabel: String,
128:     onFitPath: () -> Unit,
129:     onZoomIn: () -> Unit,
130:     onZoomOut: () -> Unit,
131:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
132: ) {
133:     Surface(modifier, color = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xF207111D)) {
134:         Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
135:             verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
136:             Spacer(Modifier.size(6.dp).background(LabGold, CircleShape))
137:             Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
138:             Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
139:                 Text("New probe", color = LabInk, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
140:                 Text(planeLabel, color = LabMuted, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
141:             }
142:             LabTextAction("Fit path", onFitPath, description = "Fit the probe and its predicted path in view")
143:             LabTextAction("−", onZoomOut, tag = SolarLabTestTags.STAGE_FIRST_CAMERA_ZOOM_OUT_BUTTON,
144:                 description = "Zoom out")
145:             LabTextAction("+", onZoomIn, tag = SolarLabTestTags.STAGE_FIRST_CAMERA_ZOOM_IN_BUTTON,
146:                 description = "Zoom in")
147:         }
155: @OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
156: @Composable
157: internal fun LabPlacementSheet(
158:     state: LabPlacementUiState,
159:     actions: LabPlacementActions,
160:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
161: ) {
162:     var sectionName by rememberSaveable {
163:         mutableStateOf(if (state.motion == LabPlacementMotion.CUSTOM) PlacementSection.MOTION.name else PlacementSection.POSITION.name)
164:     }
165:     var previousMotion by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(state.motion.name) }
166:     val section = PlacementSection.valueOf(sectionName)
167:     val positionScroll = rememberScrollState()
168:     val motionScroll = rememberScrollState()
169:     val keyboard = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
170:     val focus = LocalFocusManager.current
171:     fun showSection(value: PlacementSection) {
172:         focus.clearFocus()
173:         keyboard?.hide()
174:         sectionName = value.name
175:     }
176:     // Dragging the scene's velocity handle is a motion edit, so expose its exact values.
177:     LaunchedEffect(state.motion) {
178:         if (state.motion == LabPlacementMotion.CUSTOM && previousMotion != state.motion.name) {
179:             sectionName = PlacementSection.MOTION.name
180:         }
181:         previousMotion = state.motion.name
182:     }
183:     Surface(modifier.testTag(LabPlacementTags.ROOT), color = LabPanel,
184:         shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp), border = BorderStroke(1.dp, ColorGoldOutline.copy(alpha = 0.65f))) {
185:         BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
186:             val compactHeight = maxHeight < 256.dp
187:             Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 540.dp)) {
188:                 Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = if (compactHeight) 0.dp else 4.dp),
189:                     horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
190:                     PlacementSectionTab("Position", "${state.hosts.firstOrNull { it.id == state.hostBodyId }?.name ?: state.hostBodyId} · ${state.altitudeKmText} km",
191:                         section == PlacementSection.POSITION, !state.committing, LabPlacementTags.SECTION_POSITION,
192:                         Modifier.weight(1f)) { showSection(PlacementSection.POSITION) }
193:                     PlacementSectionTab("Motion", when (state.motion) {
194:                         LabPlacementMotion.CIRCULAR -> "Circular orbit"
195:                         LabPlacementMotion.RELEASE -> "Released at rest"
196:                         LabPlacementMotion.CUSTOM -> "${state.speedKmPerSecondText} km/s · ${state.headingDegreesText}°"
197:                     }, section == PlacementSection.MOTION, !state.committing, LabPlacementTags.SECTION_MOTION,
198:                         Modifier.weight(1f)) { showSection(PlacementSection.MOTION) }
199:                 }
200:                 HorizontalDivider(color = LabLine.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
201:                 Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()
202:                     .verticalScroll(if (section == PlacementSection.POSITION) positionScroll else motionScroll)
203:                     .testTag(LabPlacementTags.CONTENT)
204:                     .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 4.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
205:                     if (section == PlacementSection.POSITION) {
206:                         Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
207:                             Text("Around", color = LabMuted, fontSize = 12.sp, modifier = Modifier.padding(end = 8.dp))
208:                             FlowRow(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
209:                                 state.hosts.forEach { host ->
210:                                     PlacementChoice(host.name, state.hostBodyId == host.id, !state.committing,
211:                                         LabPlacementTags.host(host.id)) { actions.onHostChange(host.id) }
212:                                 }
213:                             }
214:                         }
215:                         Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
216:                             horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
217:                             PlacementNumberField(state.altitudeKmText, "Altitude · km", LabPlacementTags.ALTITUDE,
218:                                 !state.committing, Modifier.weight(1f), actions.onAltitudeChange)
219:                             Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
220:                                 Checkbox(checked = state.altitudeLocked, onCheckedChange = actions.onAltitudeLockChange,
221:                                     enabled = !state.committing,
222:                                     modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp).testTag(LabPlacementTags.ALTITUDE_LOCK)
223:                                         .semantics { contentDescription = "Lock altitude while placing" },
224:                                     colors = CheckboxDefaults.colors(checkedColor = LabGold))
225:                                 Text("Lock altitude", color = LabMuted, fontSize = 10.sp)
226:                             }
227:                         }
228:                         PlacementAltitudeSlider(state, actions.onAltitudeChange)
229:                         Text(if (state.altitudeLocked) "Drag the gold marker along the altitude ring."
230:                             else "Tap the map or drag the gold marker to place it.",
231:                             color = LabMuted, fontSize = 12.sp, lineHeight = 17.sp)
232:                     } else {
233:                         FlowRow(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
234:                             LabPlacementMotion.entries.forEach { motion ->
235:                                 PlacementChoice(when (motion) {
236:                                     LabPlacementMotion.CIRCULAR -> "Circular"
237:                                     LabPlacementMotion.RELEASE -> "Release"
238:                                     LabPlacementMotion.CUSTOM -> "Custom"
239:                                 }, state.motion == motion, !state.committing, LabPlacementTags.motion(motion)) {
240:                                     actions.onMotionChange(motion)
241:                                 }
242:                             }
243:                         }
244:                         when (state.motion) {
245:                             LabPlacementMotion.CIRCULAR -> {
246:                                 Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
247:                                     Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
248:                                         Text("Starting speed", color = LabMuted, fontSize = 11.sp)
249:                                         Text("${state.speedKmPerSecondText} km/s", color = LabInk, fontSize = 16.sp,
250:                                             modifier = Modifier.testTag(LabPlacementTags.SPEED))
251:                                     }
252:                                     PlacementDirections(state, actions)
253:                                 }
254:                                 Text("A circular starting speed around this body. Other bodies can change the orbit.",
255:                                     color = LabMuted, fontSize = 11.sp, lineHeight = 16.sp)
256:                             }
257:                             LabPlacementMotion.RELEASE -> Text(
258:                                 "Starts at rest relative to this body, then falls under gravity.",
259:                                 color = LabMuted, fontSize = 12.sp, lineHeight = 18.sp)
260:                             LabPlacementMotion.CUSTOM -> {
261:                                 Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
262:                                     PlacementNumberField(state.speedKmPerSecondText, "Speed · km/s", LabPlacementTags.SPEED,
263:                                         !state.committing, Modifier.weight(1f), actions.onSpeedChange)
264:                                     PlacementNumberField(state.headingDegreesText, "Heading · °", LabPlacementTags.HEADING,
265:                                         !state.committing, Modifier.weight(1f), actions.onHeadingChange)
266:                                 }
267:                                 Text("Drag the arrow to set direction and speed, or enter exact values here.",
268:                                     color = LabMuted, fontSize = 12.sp, lineHeight = 17.sp)
269:                             }
270:                         }
271:                     }
272:                 }
273:                 HorizontalDivider(color = LabLine.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
274:                 Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = if (compactHeight) 4.dp else 8.dp),
275:                     horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
276:                     TextButton(onClick = actions.onCancel, enabled = !state.committing,
277:                         modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag(LabPlacementTags.CANCEL)) {
278:                         Text("Cancel", color = LabMuted)
279:                     }
280:                     Column(Modifier.weight(1f).testTag(LabPlacementTags.PREVIEW), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
281:                         Text(state.error ?: state.previewStatus,
282:                             color = if (state.error != null) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error else LabGold,
283:                             fontSize = 11.sp, lineHeight = 15.sp, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
284:                         state.previewHorizonText?.let {
285:                             Text(it, color = LabMuted, fontSize = 10.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
286:                         }
287:                     }
288:                     Button(onClick = actions.onCreate, enabled = state.canCreate && !state.committing,
289:                         modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag(LabPlacementTags.CREATE),
290:                         shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
291:                         colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = LabGold, contentColor = ColorGoldInk)) {
292:                         Text(if (state.committing) "Creating…" else "Create probe", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
293:                     }
294:                 }
295:             }
296:         }
297:     }
298: }
299: 
300: @Composable
301: private fun PlacementSectionTab(
302:     title: String,
303:     summary: String,
304:     isSelected: Boolean,
305:     enabled: Boolean,
306:     tag: String,
307:     modifier: Modifier,
308:     onClick: () -> Unit,
309: ) {
310:     TextButton(onClick = onClick, enabled = enabled,
311:         modifier = modifier.height(48.dp).testTag(tag).semantics { selected = isSelected },
312:         contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 2.dp), shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
313:         colors = ButtonDefaults.textButtonColors(containerColor = if (isSelected) ColorGoldWash else androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color.Transparent)) {
314:         Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
315:             Text(title, color = if (isSelected) LabGold else LabInk, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
316:             Text(summary, color = LabMuted, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
317:         }
318:     }
319: }
320: 
321: private val ColorGoldOutline = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xFF5C4D36)
322: private val ColorGoldWash = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xFF242324)
323: private val ColorGoldInk = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xFF312716)
324: 
328:     label: String,
329:     tag: String,
330:     enabled: Boolean,
331:     modifier: Modifier,
332:     onChange: (String) -> Unit,
333: ) {
334:     val keyboard = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
335:     val focus = LocalFocusManager.current
336:     OutlinedTextField(value = value, onValueChange = onChange,
337:         label = { Text(label, fontSize = 12.sp) }, modifier = modifier.testTag(tag),
338:         singleLine = true, enabled = enabled, shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
339:         textStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium),
340:         keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Decimal, imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
341:         keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { focus.clearFocus(); keyboard?.hide() }))
342: }
343: 
344: @Composable
345: private fun PlacementChoice(label: String, isSelected: Boolean, enabled: Boolean, tag: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
346:     TextButton(onClick = onClick, enabled = enabled,
347:         modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag(tag).semantics { selected = isSelected },
348:         contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp), shape = RoundedCornerShape(13.dp),
349:         colors = ButtonDefaults.textButtonColors(contentColor = if (isSelected) LabGold else LabMuted,
350:             containerColor = if (isSelected) ColorGoldWash else androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color.Transparent)) {
351:         Text(label, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Medium,
352:             maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
353:     }
354: }
355: 
356: @Composable
357: private fun PlacementDirections(state: LabPlacementUiState, actions: LabPlacementActions) {
358:     Row {
359:         PlacementChoice("Prograde", state.direction == LabPlacementDirection.PROGRADE,
360:             !state.committing, LabPlacementTags.direction(LabPlacementDirection.PROGRADE)) {
361:             actions.onDirectionChange(LabPlacementDirection.PROGRADE)
362:         }
363:         PlacementChoice("Retrograde", state.direction == LabPlacementDirection.RETROGRADE,
364:             !state.committing, LabPlacementTags.direction(LabPlacementDirection.RETROGRADE)) {
365:             actions.onDirectionChange(LabPlacementDirection.RETROGRADE)
366:         }
367:     }
368: }
369: 
370: @Composable
371: private fun PlacementAltitudeSlider(state: LabPlacementUiState, onChange: (String) -> Unit) {
372:     val lower = state.altitudeRangeKm.start.toDouble().coerceAtLeast(0.0)
373:     val upper = state.altitudeRangeKm.endInclusive.toDouble()
374:     val validRange = lower.isFinite() && upper.isFinite() && upper > lower
375:     val logMin = if (validRange) ln(lower + 1.0) else 0.0
376:     val logSpan = if (validRange) ln(upper + 1.0) - logMin else 1.0
377:     val altitude = state.altitudeKmText.toDoubleOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isFinite() } ?: lower
378:     val progress = if (validRange) ((ln(altitude.coerceIn(lower, upper) + 1.0) - logMin) / logSpan).toFloat() else 0f
379:     Slider(value = progress.coerceIn(0f, 1f), onValueChange = {
380:         val km = (exp(logMin + it * logSpan) - 1.0).coerceIn(lower, upper)
381:         onChange(String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f", km))
382:     }, enabled = validRange && !state.committing,
383:         modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag(LabPlacementTags.ALTITUDE_SLIDER)
384:             .semantics { contentDescription = "Probe altitude" },
385:         colors = SliderDefaults.colors(thumbColor = LabGold, activeTrackColor = LabGold))
386: }
